claims.claim: An HC2 certificate must be shown when claiming a free NHS sight test through that route.
claims.quote: If this is the case for you, the NHS will ask to see proof of your entitlement. This could be a prescription prepayment certificate (PPC) , benefit award notice, or an exemption certificate.
claims.note: The eye-test page names a valid HC2 as an entitlement route and the linked general NHS page asks for exemption proof, but it does not specifically say to show the HC2.

claims.claim: A benefit award letter may be required as proof of entitlement to a free NHS sight test.
claims.quote: This could be a prescription prepayment certificate (PPC) , benefit award notice, or an exemption certificate.
claims.note: The linked NHS health-cost guidance explicitly names benefit award notices as proof and includes eye care among the charges.

claims.claim: Medical evidence must be provided when claiming a free sight test on health grounds.
claims.quote: If this is the case for you, the NHS will ask to see proof of your entitlement.
claims.note: The linked page requires proof of entitlement generally, but the supplied text does not identify medical evidence for diabetes or glaucoma sight-test routes.
